title.zh: 让 Microduck 学会自主射门
title.en: Teach Microduck to score a goal

summary.zh: 先用键盘踢球，再学习训练与感知，最后让机器人在仿真中自主完成射门。
summary.en: Play with keyboard controls, learn training and perception, then connect the full autonomous task.

meta.zh: 7 章 · 中文 / English · 仿真实践
meta.en: 8 chapters · 中文 / English · Simulation labs

blocks.zh: 最终场景中只有一台 Microduck、一个足球和一个球门。机器人要先找到球、判断球门方向，再走到合适的出脚位置完成踢球，并恢复稳定站姿。课程以 NVIDIA Isaac 生态的完整工作流组织这些环节：Isaac Lab 定义任务、观测、动作与并行环境，Newton 推进接触丰富的物理状态，Isaac Sim 提供可视化、RTX 相机与场景验证。您会看到每项工具解决的具体问题，也会学习如何用记录与评测判断整条链路。
blocks.en: The final scene contains one Microduck, one football, and one goal. The robot must find the ball, locate the goal, approach a useful kicking position, make contact, and recover its stance. You will learn what each part of this system does and how the parts work together.

zh: 说明关节、执行器、观测、动作和奖励之间的关系。
说明 Isaac Lab 3 如何分离物理、渲染与可视化，并在课程的 Newton / Isaac Sim 组合中加载固定策略。
利用 Isaac Lab 的并行环境运行一次有预算限制的 GPU 并行训练练习，找到检查点并解释训练曲线。
把 Isaac Sim 相机、ToF 距离和身体姿态联系起来，解释感知信息如何驱动自主射门的状态切换。
记录完整任务的成功与失败，区分模型指标和任务指标。
en: Explain how joints, actuators, observations, actions, and rewards relate.
Launch a Newton / Isaac Lab simulation and inspect a fixed policy in action.
Run a bounded training exercise, locate checkpoints, and interpret training curves.
Connect camera detections, ToF ranges, and body attitude to autonomous task states.
Record both successes and failures, distinguishing model metrics from task metrics.

zh: 认识 Microduck：先来踢一场球
拆解机械结构与控制周期
用 Isaac Lab 训练行走策略
探索社区的更多运动技能
设计自主射门的处理流程
回顾与延伸：在更复杂的球场上射门
en: Recap and a harder football challenge

summary.zh: 选择观看、固定模型实践或训练练习。三种方式共用同一条知识主线。
summary.en: Choose observation, fixed-model labs, or training practice. All three follow the same learning sequence.

meta.zh: 阅读 · 建议预留 5 分钟 · 无需 GPU

zh: 阅读讲解，操作 3D 模型，查看媒体示例并回答检查题。
复制命令，在本机终端运行仿真，观察与记录结果。
已准备好的 GPU 环境
在实践基础上自己训练、导出和评估。
更多运行时间和磁盘空间
en: Read, inspect the 3D assembly, watch demonstrations, and answer checks.
Copy terminal commands, run simulation, and record observations.
Add your own training, export, and evaluation.

blocks.zh: 首次学习建议先使用固定模型完成课程主线，再回到第三章、第四章和第七章练习训练流程。即使没有 GPU，也可以按顺序完成阅读；交互模型和媒体示例都无需启动 Isaac。
blocks.en: For a first pass, complete the fixed-model path, then return to Chapters 3, 4 and 7 for training. Without a GPU, follow the reading path in order. The interactive model and examples do not launch Isaac.

zh: 能够在 Linux 中打开终端、切换目录和复制多行命令。
能读懂简单的 Python 函数、数组和参数。无需先掌握 PPO。
知道坐标、角度和速度的含义；课程会解释机器人坐标系。
en: Open a Linux terminal, change directories, and copy multiline commands.
Read basic Python functions, arrays, and parameters. Prior PPO knowledge is not required.
Understand positions, angles, and velocities; robot coordinate frames are introduced in the course.

blocks.zh: 自行训练得到的检查点只是练习产物。后续章节仍默认使用 models/ 中的课程模型，不会自动选取“最近训练的模型”。如需改用自行训练的策略，必须明确指定检查点，并重新进行评估。
blocks.en: Your checkpoint is a practice artifact. Later chapters explicitly use the course models in models/; they never select the latest training run automatically. Using your own policy requires an explicit checkpoint and a new evaluation.

zh: 先阅读“预期结果”，明确需要观察的现象。
在课程仓库根目录执行命令。每个输出目录只用于一次运行。
保存运行命令、随机种子和结果，失败记录也要保留。
回答本章检查题，再进入下一章。
en: Read the expected result before running a command.
Run commands from the repository root. Use a new output directory for every run.
Keep the command, seed, and result—including failures.
Answer the chapter check before moving on.

blocks.zh: 正文标注的阅读与练习时长仅供安排学习进度，并不保证训练能在相同时间内完成。首次启动还可能需要下载资源、编译内核并创建渲染缓存。
blocks.en: Reading and exercise durations are planning estimates, not training-time guarantees. The first launch may download assets, compile kernels, and populate rendering caches.

summary.zh: 把课程页面、实验代码和固定模型放到同一个工作目录，然后检查运行环境。
summary.en: Keep the course, lab code, and fixed models in one workspace, then check the runtime.

meta.zh: 操作实验 · Ubuntu 24.04 / DGX Spark

blocks.zh: 本课程以 Ubuntu 24.04、DGX Spark（aarch64）、Python 3.12、Isaac Sim 6.2 以及锁定版本的 Isaac Lab / Newton 作为参考运行环境，仿真采用 Newton 的原生执行器路径。其他 GPU 或软件版本或许也能运行，但课程测试结果不能直接套用。
blocks.en: The reference environment is Ubuntu 24.04 on DGX Spark (aarch64), Python 3.12, Isaac Sim 6.2, and pinned Isaac Lab / Newton revisions. Simulation uses Newton’s native actuator path. Other GPUs or versions may run, but the course results do not automatically apply to them.

blocks.zh: 运行实验需要 NVIDIA 驱动、支持 GPU 的图形桌面、Git、Docker，以及能够访问 NVIDIA 软件源的网络；仅浏览课程网页则无需安装这些组件。安装 Isaac Sim 前，请先阅读其软件许可。
blocks.en: You need an NVIDIA driver, a GPU-enabled graphical desktop, Git, Docker, and network access to NVIDIA package sources. None of these are required for reading the website. Review the Isaac Sim license before installing the simulator.

blocks.code:
mkdir -p "$HOME/microduck"
cd "$HOME/microduck"
git clone https://github.com/NV-DLI/Microduck-Workshop.git
cd Microduck-Workshop
python3 scripts/workshop.py verify-models
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 模型会随仓库一同下载，无需另行登录 Hugging Face。校验命令会逐一核对文件的 SHA-256；只有全部一致后才能继续。课程固定权重应与自行生成的输出分开保存。
blocks.en: The models are included in the repository, so no Hugging Face login is required. The verification command checks every model’s SHA-256. Continue only when all files match. Course weights and student outputs are stored separately.

blocks.code:
Microduck-Workshop/
├── web/          # HTML course
├── lab/          # simulation and learning code
├── models/       # fixed course models
├── scripts/      # lab entry points
└── outputs/      # your runs (created when needed)
blocks.label: Workspace

blocks.zh: 先确认系统工具可用。下面的命令将安装 Git、Python 虚拟环境支持和视频编码工具。Docker 需要预先按照 Ubuntu 安装说明 完成配置；运行 docker info 应能看到服务信息，且不能出现权限错误。
blocks.en: First prepare system tools. The commands below install Git, Python virtual-environment support, and video encoding. Set up Docker using its Ubuntu instructions; docker info should show server information without a permission error.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y git python3-venv ffmpeg
docker info
export UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600

python3 scripts/workshop.py setup
python3 scripts/workshop.py doctor
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: setup 会显示并执行锁定版本的安装步骤；如果已有版本匹配的 Isaac Lab，可以使用 --isaaclab /你的/IsaacLab目录 进行绑定。doctor 用于检查 Python、模型、GPU、桌面显示变量和导航依赖；所有失败项都应先处理完毕。
blocks.en: setup prepares the pinned runtime. If you already have a matching Isaac Lab checkout, bind it using --isaaclab /path/to/IsaacLab. doctor checks Python, models, GPU, the desktop display setting, and navigation dependencies. Resolve failed checks before continuing.

blocks.zh: 需要图形界面的命令应在 GPU 机器的桌面终端中执行。课程网页只提供教材和命令，Isaac 窗口不会嵌入浏览器。首次打开场景时，请等待着色器和资源全部加载完成。
blocks.en: Run GUI commands in a terminal on the GPU machine’s desktop. The website provides lessons and commands; Isaac opens in its own window. On the first launch, allow shaders and assets to finish loading.

blocks.zh: 预期结果：终端显示模型输入与输出的名称、形状，以及模型的 SHA-256 标识。如果系统未识别到 GPU，请先查阅故障排查；不要通过更换物理引擎或随意下载其他模型来绕过检查。
blocks.en: Expected result: input and output names, tensor shapes, and model identity. If the GPU is unavailable, use the troubleshooting page before proceeding. Keep the pinned physics backend and model combination.

title.zh: 认识 Microduck：先来踢一场球

summary.zh: 先用键盘指挥 Microduck 走路、转向和踢球，再看看 Isaac Sim 如何把场景、机器人和预训练策略连接起来。
summary.en: Meet Microduck: play football first. Explore the concepts, run the lab, and inspect its results.

meta.zh: 第 1 章 · 自学与实践

title.zh: 一只可以学习新技能的小机器人
title.en: A small robot that learns new skills

blocks.zh: Microduck 是 Pollen Robotics 与 Hugging Face 推出的开源双足机器人。它有 14 个主动关节，可以通过训练获得行走、踢腿等技能。本课程使用 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 搭建可反复试验的场景，用 Isaac Lab 组织训练与评测，逐步让机器人自己找到足球并完成射门。先不训练：加载官方已经训练好的行走与右脚踢球 ONNX 策略，体验一次手动射门。
blocks.en: Microduck is an open biped from Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face with 14 actuated joints. Start with the official walking and right-foot kick ONNX policies in Isaac Sim, then learn how Isaac Lab trains and evaluates new skills.

title.zh: 打开球场，用键盘试一试
title.en: Open the pitch and try the keyboard

blocks.zh: 先完成环境准备，在课程仓库根目录打开终端。命令会打开 Isaac Sim，场景中的机器人、足球和球门与第 7 章自主射门任务采用相同的尺寸与物理配置。将输入法切换到英文，鼠标点击仿真窗口后，用下面的按键操作。若按键没有反应，先检查是否仍处于中文输入状态。
blocks.en: Complete setup and run this from the repository root. Click the Isaac Sim window to focus it. The robot, ball and goal use the same dimensions and physical settings as the autonomous task. Use an English keyboard input mode so an IME does not consume movement keys.

alt.zh: Isaac Sim 中的 Microduck 手动足球场景和按键面板
alt.en: Keyboard football scene and controls in Isaac Sim

blocks.zh: 先用行走策略接近足球，再停稳并切换到右脚踢球动作。
blocks.en: Walk toward the ball, stop, then switch to the right-foot kick.

zh: 给出零速度指令，回到站立
执行一次右脚踢球，然后切回站立
重置本次场景 / 退出

blocks.zh: 先走到球旁边，再停下来：球应位于右脚前方，身体朝向球门。按空格出脚。若踢空，先调整站位；若失去平衡，按 R 重来。这里由您判断球在哪里、应该朝哪走，策略只负责把指令变成关节动作。一次没有进球，也能帮助您发现自主射门系统必须解决什么问题。
blocks.en: Walk toward the ball, stop with the ball in front of the right foot, and face the goal before pressing Space. Reposition after a miss; press R after a fall. You choose the target and direction; the policies coordinate the joints.

title.zh: Isaac Sim 如何构成这场实验
title.en: How Isaac Sim builds the experiment

blocks.label: 从场景到运动
nodes: 机器人、球场、足球与球门
质量、碰撞、摩擦与执行器
键盘速度 → ONNX → 关节目标
blocks.zh: 画面、物理与策略各司其职。更换技能不需要重新制作场景；改变球的位置也不需要重新训练行走策略。
blocks.en: Rendering, physics and policy have separate roles. A different skill reuses the scene; a different ball position reuses the walking actor.

blocks.zh: 机器人 USD 不只是一张好看的网格：关节定义连接关系，碰撞形状决定接触位置，质量与惯量影响加速和转身，舵机模型影响目标角度如何变成实际运动。球的半径为 3.5 cm、质量为 45 g；球门内宽为 24 cm。Isaac Sim 提供场景与渲染，课程使用 Isaac Lab 的任务配置接入 Newton 物理后端。
blocks.en: The robot USD includes joints, collision geometry and inertial properties. The ball has a 3.5 cm radius and 45 g mass; the goal opening is 24 cm wide. Isaac Sim provides the scene and rendering; Isaac Lab configures the Newton physics backend.

title.zh: 两个不到 1 MB 的策略如何控制全身
title.en: How two small policies control the body

zh: 速度非零时行走；速度为零时站立

blocks.zh: 两个官方策略都接收 61 维观测，输出 14 个关节动作。网络包含 512、256、128 个单元的三个隐藏层，使用 ELU 激活；输入归一化参数已包含在 ONNX 中，不要再做一次不匹配的归一化。键盘没有逐个操纵关节，而是改变速度指令。出脚时速度归零，短时调用踢球策略，再平滑切回站立。这里不加载课程的踢球残差模型。
blocks.en: Both actors map 61 observations to 14 joint actions through hidden layers of 512, 256 and 128 units with ELU activations. Their input normalization is embedded in ONNX. Keyboard commands set velocity, not individual joint angles. A bounded kick blends back to standing; this lab does not load the course residual actor.

blocks.code:
obs = env.observation_manager.compute(update_history=True)['policy']
action = walk(obs)
if kick_start is not None:
    phase = (step - kick_start) * .02
    weight = 1. if phase < .14 else max(0., 1. - (phase - .14) / .12)
    if weight:
        action = torch.lerp(action, kick(obs), weight)
env.action_manager.process_action(action)
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 手动实验把踢球保持时间设为 0.14 秒，再用 0.12 秒切回站立；这是本实验的技能切换设置，不是对官方权重的重新训练。策略文件大小小于 1 MB，不代表完整仿真只需要这么多显存。
blocks.en: The lab holds the kick for 0.14 s and blends back over 0.12 s. This is a handoff setting, not retraining of the official weights. Small policy files do not imply a small simulator memory footprint.

title.zh: 刚才是谁在决定下一步

question.zh: 刚才您已经完成了哪些机器人还不会自主完成的判断？
question.en: Which decisions did you make for the robot?

answer.zh: 您识别了足球和球门、估计了距离、选择了接近路线和出脚位置，并决定何时踢球。第 6、7 章会把这些判断逐个交给感知、规划与任务控制模块。
answer.en: You identified the ball and goal, estimated distance, selected a route and stance, and decided when to kick. Chapters 6 and 7 automate those decisions.

blocks.zh: 下一章先看看这些动作背后的机械结构，以及策略和物理引擎按什么节奏协同工作。
blocks.en: Next, inspect the mechanism and the timing between policy and physics.

references.zh: Pollen Robotics：课程采用的官方策略版本

title.zh: 拆解机械结构与控制周期

summary.zh: 先把外壳、关节、执行器和传感器分开理解，再看它们如何组成一台可控制的机器人。
summary.en: Separate shells, joints, actuators, and sensors, then see how they form a controllable robot.

meta.zh: 第 2 章 · 结构交互与原理 · 无需 GPU
meta.en: Chapter 2 · Interactive anatomy · No GPU required

blocks.zh: 在 Isaac Sim 中，机器人模型不仅包含外观，还定义关节、碰撞几何和质量属性。先认识 Microduck 的机械结构，后续才能把关节名称、动作向量与仿真中的运动对应起来。Isaac Lab 会在此基础上组织观测、动作和训练任务。
Microduck 是一台小型双足机器人：双腿承担支撑与移动，颈部机构负责调整视线，机身则容纳计算、电源和连接部件。视觉网格用于呈现外观，关节与碰撞模型用于规定可发生的运动和接触，二者在仿真中承担不同职责。
blocks.en: Microduck is a small biped. Its legs support and move the body, the neck directs its view, and the trunk houses computing, power, and connections. Visual meshes describe appearance. Joints and collision geometry describe permitted motion and contact. These play different roles in simulation.

blocks.zh: 操作时，先把爆炸滑块移到中间位置，通过可点击标签找到左右腿的舵机；再把滑块移到最右端，依次点击头部镜头、外壳和主板的标签。最后复位滑块，观察各部件如何借助连接件组成运动链。
blocks.en: Try this: move the explosion slider halfway and find the leg servos. Fully expand the assembly and select the lens, shells, and boards. Reset the view and trace how the connectors form a kinematic chain.

blocks.zh: 这份机械 CAD 包含 15 个舵机实体，而对应的仿真导出包含 14 个活动关节；喙部机构没有作为独立的策略关节。CAD 中电子部件的外形对应原始硬件版本，第六章会另行说明所用的 Beta 传感器配置。
blocks.en: This CAD assembly contains 15 servo bodies. Its simulation export exposes 14 active joints; the beak is not an independent policy joint. Electronic shapes belong to the source CAD revision. Chapter 5 separately describes the Beta sensing configuration.

title.zh: 先分清零件、关节和自由度
title.en: Parts, joints, and degrees of freedom

blocks.zh: 一支笔以笔尖为支点时可以朝多个方向转动，而铰链通常只能绕一条固定轴旋转，机器人关节也受到类似约束。自由度表示描述允许运动所需的独立变量数量，零件数量则表示装配体包含多少实体，两者并不相等。因此，网页中展示 70 个组件，并不意味着策略需要输出 70 个动作。
blocks.en: A pen held at its tip can rotate in several directions, while a hinge normally rotates around one fixed axis. Robot joints impose similar constraints. A degree of freedom is an independent variable needed to describe permitted motion; a component count describes physical pieces. The 70 components in this viewer do not imply 70 policy actions.

zh: 髋偏航、髋侧倾、髋俯仰、膝、踝，共 5 个
颈俯仰、头俯仰、头偏航、头侧倾，共 4 个
改变相机朝向与头部姿态
实物有舵机；本课程策略不控制
仅用于 CAD 展示，不计入 14 维策略动作
en: Hip yaw, roll, pitch; knee; ankle: 5 joints
Support the body and place the foot
Neck pitch; head pitch, yaw, roll: 4 joints
Physical servo; not controlled by this policy
Shown in CAD, excluded from the 14-action interface

blocks.zh: 点击髋部舵机的标签，观察输出轴及其附近的轴承。舵机控制主动转角，轴承支撑旋转部件，支架则连接相邻关节。材料、几何形状和装配间隙都会影响运动。网页模型保留了原 CAD 的细节，但没有模拟螺钉预紧、塑料弹性或线缆受力，因此只能帮助理解结构，不能替代制造图纸。
blocks.en: Select a hip servo and inspect its output shaft and nearby bearing. The servo controls an active angle, the bearing supports rotation, and brackets connect adjacent joints. Material, shape, and assembly clearance affect motion. The viewer preserves CAD detail but does not simulate screw preload, plastic elasticity, or cable forces; it is an anatomy aid rather than manufacturing documentation.

blocks.zh: 策略不会直接把机器人移动到指定位置，而是输出一组动作，再由动作接口转换成关节目标。执行器根据目标状态与实际状态之间的差异产生力矩；机器人最终如何运动，还会受到接触、重力、惯量和摩擦的共同影响。
blocks.en: A policy does not teleport the robot to a desired position. It outputs actions that become joint targets. Actuators produce torque based on the difference between target and measured state. The resulting motion depends on contact, gravity, inertia, and friction.

blocks.zh: 本课程的控制循环频率为 50 Hz，物理步进频率为 200 Hz，因此每个策略动作会持续四个物理步。齿隙模型还会引入被动关节来描述传动间隙，但这些关节并不是额外的策略输出。
blocks.en: The policy runs at 50 Hz and physics at 200 Hz: each action spans four physics steps. Backlash introduces passive joints representing transmission play. Passive joints are not additional policy outputs.

zh: 场地、球门和机器人整体位置
前进、侧移、转向指令以及球相对身体的位置
图像射线与检测目标方向
一个关节的旋转轴与角度
en: Pitch, goal, and overall robot position
Forward, lateral, and turn commands; ball relative to the robot
Image rays and detected target directions

question.zh: 头部关节保持不动时，相机画面一定稳定吗？
question.en: If the head joints stay fixed, is the camera image necessarily stable?

answer.zh: 不一定。机身可能发生俯仰和横滚，颈部也会随之运动。判断画面是否稳定，应观察相机相对于世界坐标系的姿态，不能只看头部关节角度。
answer.en: No. Body pitch and roll move the neck and camera. Image stability depends on camera orientation relative to the world, not only on joint angles.

title.zh: 练习：沿一条受力路径找部件

blocks.zh: 先让模型保持装配状态，找到左脚，并沿脚踝、小腿、膝部、大腿和髋部向上追踪。脚掌着地后，支撑力会沿这条路径传到机身。随后拖动爆炸滑块展开模型，点击关节附近的舵机和支架标签，辨认哪个部件固定在上一级、哪个部件随输出轴旋转。爆炸图只改变部件的显示位置，并不代表真实关节能够运动到这些位置。
blocks.en: Start with the assembled model. Trace a path from the left foot through the ankle, shin, knee, thigh, and hip. Ground support reaches the body through this chain. Explode the assembly and select the servos and brackets around a joint. Identify the fixed housing and the part driven by its output. Explosion offsets are display positions, not physically reachable joint poses.

blocks.zh: 舵机内部不仅有电机，还包括减速齿轮、位置反馈和控制电路。收到目标角度后，舵机需要一定时间进行跟踪，并受到可用扭矩、速度、摩擦和齿隙的限制。因此，“策略输出一个角度”不等于“关节立即到达该角度”。本章说明这一差别，第三章则介绍策略如何适应它。
blocks.en: A servo combines a motor, reduction gears, position feedback, and control electronics. Reaching a target takes time and is limited by torque, speed, friction, and backlash. A policy issuing an angle does not mean the joint instantly reaches it. Chapter 2 observes this difference; Chapter 3 explains how a policy learns around it.

question.zh: 在爆炸图中把脚部拉得更远，会改变仿真的腿长吗？
question.en: Does moving the foot farther out in the exploded view change the simulated leg length?

answer.zh: 不会。网页中的爆炸图只用于认识组件，仿真里的部件长度和关节连接仍由机器人描述文件定义。
answer.en: No. The web view explains components. Robot description files define simulated dimensions and joint connections.

title.zh: 策略收到什么，又输出什么
title.en: What the policy receives and produces

blocks.zh: 第一章使用已经训练好的策略进行推理：它把当前观测映射为 14 个关节动作，运行过程中不会更新神经网络参数。需要特别区分的是，更改速度指令只是在测试同一个模型的响应，并非重新训练；只有更换模型文件才会改变策略。
blocks.en: Chapter 1 runs inference with a trained policy. It maps the current observation to 14 joint actions without updating neural-network parameters. Changing the velocity command tests the same model under a different request; it is not training. Choosing a different model file changes the policy.

zh: 角速度与身体坐标下的重力方向
身体正在怎样转动、倾斜
当前姿态与默认姿态的差异
上一次的控制输出，为策略提供时序信息
速度、头部与身体姿态指令
这一步希望机器人做什么
en: Pose relative to the nominal posture
Previous control output and temporal context

blocks.zh: 这些数值合计构成 61 维输入。即使输入形状仍为 61，只要打乱关节顺序，语义就会被破坏，例如策略可能把膝关节状态误当成髋关节状态。课程入口会保持关节顺序、默认姿态和控制节拍一致。应先通过指令、时间预算和输出目录开展实验，理解接口后再修改底层观测。
blocks.en: These values total 61. Reordering joints breaks their meaning even if the input still has 61 entries: the policy might read a knee as a hip. Course entry points preserve ordering, nominal posture, and control timing. Begin by changing commands, duration, and output directories; modify observation construction only after understanding the interface.

title.zh: 用 Isaac Lab 训练行走策略

summary.zh: 用 Isaac Lab 的并行环境在 GPU 上体验一次 PPO 训练，理解观测、动作、奖励、管理器和检查点，并学习如何验证策略。
summary.en: Experience PPO training and understand observations, actions, rewards, and checkpoints while keeping downstream labs on fixed models.

meta.zh: 第 3 章 · 阅读 · 建议预留 30 分钟 · 训练练习可选
meta.en: Chapter 3 · About 30 minutes reading · Optional training

blocks.zh: Isaac Lab 把一项机器人学习任务拆成可组合的场景、观测、动作、命令、奖励、事件和终止项。策略接收机身姿态、角速度、关节状态、速度指令和上一动作，输出关节动作；Newton 在 GPU 上并行推进多个环境，奖励管理器计算反馈，PPO 收集一批交互后更新参数，再继续采样。这样可以在同一份任务定义中批量生成训练数据，也能逐项检查奖励和终止条件。
blocks.en: The policy receives a vector containing body attitude, angular velocity, joint state, a velocity command, and the previous action. It outputs joint actions, physics advances, and rewards measure progress toward the objective. PPO collects a batch of interactions, updates the policy, and samples again.

blocks.zh: “环境数量”决定 Isaac Lab 在 GPU 上向量化运行多少个机器人副本，“迭代次数”决定重复多少轮采样与更新。每个副本都保留独立状态；事件与终止管理器可以只重置已结束的环境，使其他副本继续采样。增加环境数量通常能提高每轮采样量，但也会占用更多显存。训练奖励上升只说明策略在优化目标上的表现有所改善，实际行为仍需在独立场景中检验。
blocks.en: The environment count is the number of simultaneous robot copies. Iterations repeat collection and optimization. More environments increase parallel sampling and memory demand. A rising training reward means the optimized objective is improving; independent behavior checks are still necessary.

title.zh: PPO 为什么不是“每一步奖励高就保留”
title.en: Why PPO looks beyond immediate reward

blocks.zh: 机器人迈步时，短暂抬起一只脚会暂时降低稳定性，却又是向前移动的必要动作。因此，强化学习关注一段时间内的累计回报，而不是只评价当前一步。折扣因子会让更远期奖励的权重逐渐降低，从而平衡短期反馈与长期效果。
blocks.en: Lifting a foot can briefly reduce stability while being necessary for forward progress. Reinforcement learning therefore considers return over time rather than just the current reward. A discount factor reduces the weight of more distant rewards, balancing immediate feedback with longer-term consequences.

blocks.zh: 在 PPO 中，actor 根据观测选择动作，critic 则估计从当前状态出发能够获得的预期回报。当某个动作的结果优于 critic 的预期时，优势估计为正，更新会倾向于提高该动作出现的概率；结果不及预期时则相反。PPO 通过限制单次更新偏离旧策略的幅度来减轻策略突变带来的不稳定，但它并不保证每次更新都能提升真实任务的成功率。
blocks.en: In PPO, the actor chooses actions and the critic estimates future return. An outcome better than the critic expected receives a positive advantage estimate, encouraging a higher probability for the corresponding action; a worse outcome does the opposite. PPO limits how far an update moves from the old policy to reduce abrupt changes. It does not guarantee that every update improves real task success.

blocks.zh: 训练期间可以向 critic 提供更多仿真信息，帮助它评价轨迹；部署后的 actor 却只能依赖运行时实际可获得的观测。例如，仿真引擎能够读取精确的机身速度，并不代表真实机器人拥有毫无误差的速度传感器。仅供训练或评分使用的真值不得接入部署控制器。
blocks.en: A critic may receive additional simulation information to evaluate trajectories, but the deployed actor must depend only on observations available at runtime. A simulator knowing exact body velocity does not imply that hardware has a perfect velocity sensor. Keep training or scoring ground truth out of the deployed controller.

blocks.zh: 设计奖励时，应先列出期望行为，再分析策略可能利用的捷径。例如，“奖励球移动”可能诱使机器人用身体撞球，“奖励保持不动”则可能使其拒绝行走。可行的检查方法是同时记录目标指标与约束，包括速度误差、回合长度、摔倒情况、关节范围和触球方式。第三章只用于练习训练循环，完整任务的成功标准将在第七章检验。
blocks.en: When designing rewards, list desired behaviors and then consider shortcuts. Rewarding ball motion may encourage body collisions; rewarding stillness may discourage walking. Track both goals and constraints: velocity error, episode length, falls, joint limits, and contact type. This chapter practices the training loop; Chapter 7 tests the complete task definition.

blocks.zh: 这项练习旨在走通训练工作流，20 次迭代只是练习预算，不表示策略已经学会行走。预期结果：终端显示训练进度，新目录中生成训练记录、检查点和导出的策略。练习重点是观察损失、回报与回合长度如何变化，无需等待长时间训练。
blocks.en: This is a workflow exercise, not a promise that 20 iterations will learn to walk. Expected result: terminal progress, a new run directory, checkpoints, and an exported policy. Observe loss, return, and episode length without committing to a long training run.

blocks.zh: 在浏览器中打开终端显示的本地 TensorBoard 地址，观察回报与回合长度是否同步改善。如果回报有所增长但回合仍然很短，应检查奖励设计是否允许机器人短暂得分后立即摔倒。
blocks.en: Open the local TensorBoard address printed in the terminal. Compare reward with episode length. If reward grows while episodes remain short, consider whether the objective rewards a brief action followed by a fall.

title.zh: 从流程检查到完整训练
title.en: From a smoke run to a longer training run

blocks.zh: 20 轮练习用于确认采样、PPO 更新、保存与导出都能运行，不足以证明机器人学会行走。若要继续体验技能形成，可另开一个输出目录，增加并行环境数与训练轮数。下面给出 1024 个环境、2500 轮的训练预算；是否已经收敛，仍要看曲线与独立评测，不能只看轮数。
blocks.en: The 20-iteration exercise checks the pipeline, not convergence. A longer run below uses 1024 environments for 2500 iterations in a new output directory. Judge convergence with curves and independent evaluation, not iteration count alone.

blocks.zh: 训练时打开 TensorBoard，检查回合奖励、回合长度、跌倒与速度误差是否共同改善。若只做短练习，下一节使用 outputs/student-walk-01/exported/policy.onnx；若完成了上面的训练，则显式换成 outputs/walking-training-01/exported/policy.onnx。两种练习都不会覆盖官方模型。
blocks.en: Use TensorBoard to compare reward, episode length, falls and velocity error. Use the short-run export in the next section, or explicitly select outputs/walking-training-01/exported/policy.onnx after this longer run. Neither changes the official model.

blocks.zh: 此处必须明确选择自行训练的模型，并将其支撑、漂移和摔倒情况与第一章的官方模型进行比较。完成练习后，后续章节仍会使用 models/walk.onnx；本次导出不会改变课程的默认策略。
blocks.en: Here you deliberately select your own model. Compare support, drift, and falls with the official model from Chapter 1. Later lessons still use models/walk.onnx; this export does not change their default.

blocks.zh: 如需增加训练预算，请新建输出目录，并将环境数和迭代数调整为例如 1024 与 500；开始前先确认内存和可用时间。保存检查点不代表策略已经合格，还应使用未参与训练的种子进行评估，并保留失败结果。
blocks.en: To increase the budget, choose a new output directory and try, for example, 1,024 environments and 500 iterations. Check available memory and time first. A saved checkpoint is not a qualification result. Evaluate unseen seeds and retain failures.

blocks.zh: 比较时，两次运行的速度、时长与种子必须相同。先比较有没有跌倒、实际前进距离与速度，再测试零速度时能否站稳。不要把一次“走出去”的视频当成完整技能通过；曲线变好却没有达到目标，也是一条需要解释的实验结果。
blocks.en: Match command, duration and seed. Compare falls, distance and actual velocity, then test standing at zero command. One moving demonstration is not a complete skill benchmark.

blocks.zh: 真实舵机的摩擦、延迟和齿隙并不会在每次运行中完全一致。Isaac Lab 的事件管理器可以在环境重置或指定时刻为各并行副本改变这些参数，让策略在同一训练批次中接触更丰富的情形。随机化范围过窄可能造成过拟合，范围过宽又可能使任务难以学会。课程使用保存于 env.yaml 的实际配置作为解释依据；域随机化有助于提高鲁棒性，但不能取代真机验证。
blocks.en: Real actuators do not have identical friction, delay, and backlash on every run. Varying parameters in training exposes the policy to more conditions. A narrow range can overfit; an excessively broad range can make learning difficult. Randomization can improve robustness but does not replace hardware testing.

question.zh: 为什么不能把训练过程中回报最高的一次当作独立测试结果？
question.en: Why is the highest-reward training episode not an independent test?

answer.zh: 因为这次结果已经参与学习或模型选择，而且奖励高并不必然等于任务成功。独立测试应预先确定场景和成功标准，并在未参与选型的条件下统计全部结果。
answer.en: It contributed to learning or selection, and reward may differ from task success. Independent testing uses predetermined scenarios and success criteria and counts every outcome.

title.zh: 检查点、训练曲线与独立测试

blocks.zh: 训练从随机参数开始，不会加载课程提供的行走权重。每轮 PPO 都先从多个环境收集轨迹，再利用这些轨迹更新策略。奖励通常由速度跟踪、机身姿态、动作平滑性和接触相关项共同组成。两个总奖励相同的策略，可能分别依靠“速度更准确”和“少动更稳定”获得分数，因此必须同时检查实际行为与各项奖励。
blocks.en: Practice starts from random parameters rather than the course walking weights. Each PPO iteration gathers trajectories from several environments and then updates the policy. Rewards combine velocity tracking, body attitude, action smoothness, and contact-related terms. Two policies with similar total rewards may obtain them through accurate motion or simply moving less; inspect both behavior and individual reward terms.

blocks.zh: initial.pt 保存训练起点，model_*.pt 保存训练检查点，env.yaml 和 agent.yaml 保存环境与优化配置，exported/policy.onnx 则是供推理使用的导出文件。检查点可能包含优化器等训练状态，而 ONNX 通常只保留推理所需的计算图，因此两种文件格式不能随意互换。
blocks.en: initial.pt records initialization; model_*.pt files are checkpoints; env.yaml and agent.yaml preserve environment and optimizer settings; exported/policy.onnx is the inference export. A checkpoint can contain optimizer state, while ONNX normally preserves the inference graph. They are not interchangeable file formats.

blocks.zh: 建议记录三项信息：训练预算、未参与训练的测试种子和实际行为。20 轮练习只用于走通采样、更新、保存与导出流程；即使练习模型表现不佳，也不要因此替换后续章节的固定模型。增加预算时应保留原实验、使用新的输出目录，并注明改动的是环境数、迭代数还是奖励。
blocks.en: Record the training budget, held-out test seeds, and observed behavior. The 20-iteration exercise teaches sampling, updates, saving, and export. A weak practice policy is no reason to replace downstream course defaults. For a larger budget, keep the earlier run, use a new output directory, and state whether you changed environment count, iteration count, or rewards.

question.zh: 只保存 ONNX 文件，能否保证从中精确续训？
question.en: Does saving only ONNX guarantee an exact training continuation?

answer.zh: 不能。精确续训还需要优化器状态、归一化状态、随机状态以及相同的配置等信息，因此必须保留完整检查点和训练配置。
answer.en: No. Exact continuation also needs optimizer, normalization and random states, together with matching configuration. Preserve full checkpoints and training settings.

title.zh: 平地上学会的动作，能走上坡吗
title.en: Will a flat-ground skill handle a slope?

blocks.zh: 现在有了一个行走策略，也知道怎样用 Isaac Lab 收集数据、更新 PPO、导出 ONNX 并独立测试。但训练时脚下大多是平地：如果把球场换成坡道，原来的抬脚高度、落脚位置和重心调整还够用吗？先写下您的预测，再到下一章用相同的策略做对照实验。
blocks.en: You can now collect rollouts, update PPO, export ONNX and test a policy. Will its foot clearance and balance adjustments work on a slope? Predict the outcome, then test the same policy in Chapter 4.

summary.zh: 用 Isaac Sim 构建可控的坡道，在 Isaac Lab 中测试现有策略，再用多种地形训练并比较结果。
summary.en: Adapt walking to slopes. Explore the concepts, run the lab, and inspect its results.

meta.zh: 第 4 章 · 自学与实践

blocks.zh: 本章不预设“旧模型一定会摔倒”。任务是从平地出发，走上或走下一段坡道，抵达另一端并保持平衡。先固定模型、速度、时长、摩擦和起点扰动，只改变坡度。这样才能判断性能变化来自地形，而不是换了几项设置。
blocks.en: Do not assume the old actor will fail. Hold the policy, command, duration, friction and initial-state distribution fixed while varying slope. Test traversal and balance, not just a single attractive frame.

blocks.label: 地形泛化实验
nodes: 同一策略：平地 / 上坡 / 下坡
对比到达率、跌倒率与速度误差
blocks.zh: 先测后训；保留平地能力，再检查坡地能力是否提高。
blocks.en: Evaluate before adapting. Retain flat-ground ability while testing improvements on slopes.

title.zh: 搭建平地—坡道—平台场景

blocks.zh: 评测场景由三段连续表面组成：出发后 0.35 m 为平地，接着是水平长度 1 m 的坡道，最后是落脚平台。正角度表示上坡，负角度表示下坡。用一个连续碰撞网格连接它们，避免装饰性台阶意外改变实验。视觉材质与灯光用于辨认坡面；质量、摩擦和碰撞几何才决定接触运动。
blocks.en: The surface has a 0.35 m flat approach, a 1 m horizontal ramp, and a landing. Positive angles ascend; negative angles descend. A continuous collision mesh avoids unintended steps. Visual materials do not determine contact dynamics.

alt.zh: Isaac Sim 中的平地、上坡和目标线
alt.en: Isaac Sim flat approach, ramp and target line

blocks.zh: 深色区域标出坡面，金色虚线帮助观察行走方向，绿色横线是到达位置的参考标记。标线与颜色不改变物理接触。
blocks.en: The darker surface marks the ramp; gold guides show direction and green marks the target. These visual markings do not change contact physics.

blocks.label: 平地、坡道与平台的侧视图
blocks.zh: 拖动滑块比较上坡与下坡。横向和高度使用相同比例；改变坡度会同时改变平台高度。
blocks.en: Adjust the slope to compare ascent and descent. Horizontal and vertical scales match; the landing height changes with the angle.

blocks.code:
slope = math.tan(math.radians(cfg.slope_deg))
xs = [0., 2.35, 3.35, 6.]
zs = [0., 0., slope, slope]
vertices = [(x, y, z) for x, z in zip(xs, zs) for y in [0., 4.]]
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 网格内部使用偏移后的局部坐标；机器人起点对应上式的 x = 0。通过 Isaac Lab 的 TerrainGenerator 和 TerrainImporter，可让同一几何用于可视化与物理测试，并为并行训练批量生成地形。
blocks.en: The mesh uses offset local coordinates; the robot spawn corresponds to x = 0 in the equation. Isaac Lab TerrainGenerator and TerrainImporter reuse this geometry for visualization, physics and parallel tasks.

title.en: Test the official walking policy first

blocks.zh: 不加 --headless 会打开 Isaac Sim。批量评测时使用 --num-envs 5 --headless；将坡度依次改为 0、5、−5、10、−10、15、−15，并给每次运行使用新的输出目录。前 2 秒站立，随后给出 0.25 m/s 前进指令；实际速度由策略和物理系统共同决定，并不保证等于指令。
blocks.en: Without --headless this opens Isaac Sim. Use --num-envs 5 --headless for batched evaluation, and test 0, ±5, ±10 and ±15 degrees in separate output directories. The first 2 s are standing; then the command is 0.25 m/s. Actual speed may differ.

blocks.zh: 达到目标须在 20 秒内走到 x ≥ 1.45 m，抵达时横向偏移小于 0.3 m，并且整段实验不跌倒。跌倒后不自动重置；机器人即使随后滑过终点，也不计为成功。报告分别保存到达情况、跌倒情况和速度均方根误差。
blocks.en: Success requires reaching x ≥ 1.45 m within 20 s with lateral error below 0.3 m and staying upright throughout. A fall remains a failure even if the body later slides across the finish. Reports separate reaching, falls and velocity RMSE.

blocks.zh: 这组基线每个坡度使用 5 个起点轻微扰动的环境。平地 5/5 通过；上坡没有跌倒，但停滞在坡道中；下坡 5/5 跌倒。它说明当前模型需要适应这些地形，但样本数较小，不应据此推断任意坡地的可靠性。
blocks.en: Each angle uses five lightly perturbed starts. Flat trials pass; uphill trials stall without falling; downhill trials fall. This small baseline identifies an adaptation need, not general reliability.

title.zh: 为什么平地经验不能直接覆盖坡地
title.en: Why flat-ground experience may not transfer

blocks.zh: 坡面改变了脚与地面的相对高度、重力沿坡方向的分量和可用摩擦。上坡时，抬脚和推进不足可能让机器人停在坡上；下坡时，重心向前移动与落脚高度变化可能让机器人来不及恢复平衡。仅看“是否摔倒”会漏掉上坡停滞，因此到达率与速度误差也很重要。
blocks.en: A slope changes foot clearance, gravity along the surface and usable friction. Insufficient clearance or propulsion can stall ascent; downhill landing and balance changes can cause falls. Survival alone misses stalled traversal.

blocks.label: 坡面上的重力分量与简化摩擦约束

blocks.zh: 这只是帮助理解的准静态近似。双足行走还涉及惯性、单脚支撑和碰撞；Newton 按每个物理步推进这些动力学与接触，不能用上式直接推出一个策略一定能走多陡的坡。Isaac Lab 3 将学习任务与物理后端分开，本章继续使用 Newton 的原生执行器与相同控制周期。
blocks.en: These are quasi-static intuitions, not a maximum-slope guarantee. Newton advances dynamics, contact and actuators at every physics step. Isaac Lab 3 separates the learning task from its physics backend; this lesson retains native Newton actuators.

title.zh: 在多种地形中继续学习

blocks.zh: 保留官方 ONNX，复制其网络权重与归一化参数作为新策略的起点。训练使用 25% 平地、其余为不同坡度的上坡和下坡地形；环境并行收集不同状态下的经验。新价值网络与优化器单独初始化。训练前先检查新策略网络与原 ONNX 对同一观测的输出一致，避免接口错误被误认为“需要更多训练”。
blocks.en: Keep the official ONNX unchanged. Initialize a new actor from its weights and normalization, with a fresh critic and optimizer. Mix 25% flat terrain with ascending and descending terrain. Verify initial actor parity before learning.

blocks.zh: 这里的坡度参数是 tan(α)，不是角度值；范围 0.03–0.22 对应约 1.7°–12.4°。训练地形使用金字塔坡面与反向坡面，评测保留直线坡道，因此不是在训练场景原位重复演示。训练和评测随机种子也分开。
blocks.en: Training slopes are tan(α), not degrees: 0.03–0.22 is about 1.7°–12.4°. Training uses pyramidal and inverted slopes; evaluation uses straight ramps and separate seeds.

blocks.code:
sub_terrains={
    'flat': MeshPlaneTerrainCfg(proportion=.25),
    'slopes': HfPyramidSlopedTerrainCfg(
        proportion=.375, slope_range=(.03, .22), platform_width=.7),
    'descending': HfInvertedPyramidSlopedTerrainCfg(
        proportion=.375, slope_range=(.03, .22), platform_width=.7),
}
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

title.zh: 不仅要站稳，还要走向目标

blocks.zh: 地形适应后，还要检查方向是否准确。机器人即使一直迈步，也可能因小幅偏航逐渐偏离目标。速度跟踪、身体稳定和方向保持应分别观察：若把转向误差与步态正常的横滚、俯仰运动混在同一个狭窄奖励范围里，训练信号可能不够清晰。这里增加一个只针对身体 z 轴角速度的跟踪项，同时保留姿态与动作平滑约束。
blocks.en: After adapting balance, check direction. Small turn-rate errors can accumulate into missed targets. A separate body-z angular-velocity term avoids mixing turn accuracy with ordinary gait roll and pitch; posture and smoothness terms remain.

blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 其中 ωz 为身体 z 轴角速度，ωz* 为转向指令，单位均为 rad/s；0.15 控制误差容忍范围。权重 4 决定这个奖励与其他奖励项的相对重要性。转向奖励衡量角速度跟踪情况；能否完成坡地行走，仍由到达与跌倒条件判断。沿用上一阶段的检查点，可以继续改进已有动作，无需重新从随机策略开始。
blocks.en: Both angular velocities use rad/s; 0.15 sets tolerance and weight4 controls relative importance. This is not a task-success metric. Resume the previous checkpoint to improve the existing motion rather than restarting from random parameters.

blocks.label: Terminal
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py train-terrain \
  --model models/walk.onnx \
  --resume outputs/terrain-training-01/model_999.pt \
  --refine-heading --num-envs 256 --iterations 1500 --seed 43002 \
  --output outputs/terrain-heading-01

python3 scripts/workshop.py train-terrain \
  --model models/walk.onnx \
  --resume outputs/terrain-heading-01/model_2498.pt \
  --refine-heading --yaw-precision \
  --num-envs 256 --iterations 2000 --seed 43003 \
  --output outputs/terrain-direction-01

blocks.zh: 第一条续训命令加强角速度跟踪，并固定名义物理参数；第二条加入独立转向奖励。这里是受控地形适应实验，尚不覆盖广泛的摩擦、质量和传感器噪声变化。检查点编号由训练器保存；若自行改变前面的轮数，请以输出目录中的实际文件名为准。每阶段保留独立日志和导出文件，原官方策略始终保留。
blocks.en: The first continuation strengthens angular tracking and fixes nominal physical parameters. The second adds the separate turn-rate reward. Broad friction, mass and sensor-noise robustness is outside this controlled experiment. If you change iteration budgets, use the checkpoint filenames actually saved. Every stage keeps separate logs and exports.

blocks.zh: 本课程固定坡地策略采用以上 256 个环境、共 4500 轮的训练预算。DGX Spark 上记录的三个训练阶段分别约为 8.1、9.8、13.2 分钟，合计约 31.1 分钟；计时不含环境初始化与评测。每轮采集 256 × 24 = 6144 条状态转换。并行环境共享同一策略，但提供不同地形和状态下的经验；更多环境并不意味着总耗时一定按比例缩短。
blocks.en: The fixed terrain actor uses256 environments and4500 total iterations. Recorded training stages on DGX Spark took about8.1,9.8 and13.2 minutes, totaling31.1 minutes, excluding environment initialization and evaluation. Each iteration collects256×24=6144 transitions. Parallel worlds share a policy but provide varied experience; scaling is not necessarily linear.

blocks.zh: 在 TensorBoard 中同时查看速度跟踪奖励、转向奖励、地形难度和回合长度。曲线用于定位问题，下面的统一评测用于判断任务是否完成。若只想体验短训练，完成前 1000 轮即可；后续实验直接使用仓库中的固定坡地策略，练习结果不会自动替换它。
blocks.en: Inspect tracking rewards, terrain difficulty and episode length in TensorBoard. Curves diagnose learning; the matched benchmark checks task completion. For a shorter exercise, stop after the first1000 iterations and use the fixed course terrain actor downstream.

title.zh: 用同一把尺子比较新旧策略
title.en: Compare both actors with the same benchmark

alt.zh: 上坡 10°时官方策略与坡地策略对比

blocks.zh: 上坡 10°：上方为官方策略，下方为坡地策略。同一速度指令下，前者在坡道前部停滞，后者继续走到目标区域。两次运行使用相同的起点设置，按仿真时间同步播放；这是单组演示，整体表现以下表为准。
blocks.en: Ascent10°: official actor above, terrain actor below. The original stalls while the adapted actor reaches the target. Matched starts and synchronized simulation time; this illustration does not replace the full benchmark.

alt.zh: 下坡 10°时官方策略与坡地策略对比

blocks.zh: 下坡 10°：上方为官方策略，下方为坡地策略。官方策略失去平衡；坡地策略保持站立，但这次运行的横向偏移超出目标范围，仍判为未通过。两次运行使用相同的起点设置，按仿真时间同步播放。这组演示使用单独的种子，不计入下表；它说明“没有跌倒”不等于“完成任务”。
blocks.en: Descent10°: official actor above, terrain actor below. The original falls; the terrain actor stays upright but misses the lateral arrival region, so this run also fails. Matched starts and synchronized simulation time. This separate illustration seed is not included in the table: survival is not task completion.

blocks.zh: 默认使用已训练好的 models/terrain-walk.onnx，大小约 0.79 MB；想评估自己的模型时，将路径显式改为 outputs/terrain-direction-01/exported/policy.onnx。这个坡地模型只用于本章，第一章与第七章仍使用原行走策略。
blocks.en: Use the fixed0.79 MB terrain actor by default. Explicitly select outputs/terrain-direction-01/exported/policy.onnx to test your own export. Chapters1 and7 retain the original walking actor.

blocks.zh: 对官方模型和新模型使用相同的评测种子与坡度表。至少同时报告平地、上坡和下坡的通过数、跌倒数、速度误差及训练耗时。没有跌倒但停在坡上，属于未完成任务；坡地改善却丢失平地能力，也不算合格替代。学生训练出的模型只有经过这样的验证，才适合显式替换默认策略。
blocks.en: Use matched evaluation seeds and angles for both actors. Report flat, uphill and downhill success, falls, tracking error and training time. Stalling is not success, and slope improvements do not justify losing flat-ground ability.

blocks.zh: 表中每个坡度各运行 5 个环境，使用未参与调参的评测种子 44001。通过要求与前面完全相同；速度 RMSE 仅统计首次跌倒前、开始前进后的采样，避免跌落后的运动混入行走误差。到达时横向偏移小于 0.3 m，不等于全程严格沿直线行走。样本较少，这些结果不能推广为任意坡地的成功率。完整条件与逐环境结果见评测数据。
blocks.en: Each angle uses five environments with held-out seed44001. Success criteria are unchanged. Speed RMSE includes moving-command samples only before the first fall. The lateral gate applies at arrival, not continuously. This small sample does not establish general slope reliability. See the per-environment results.

blocks.zh: 新策略保留了平地能力，并改善了中小坡度的通过情况；下坡 10°仍有一次偏离到达区域，±15°则出现明显的跌倒问题。继续扩大地形范围前，应先检查失败轨迹，再决定是否增加训练难度或调整奖励。不要把这份坡地策略直接替换进自主射门系统：行走接口相同，并不意味着与接近控制、站位和踢球切换的配合已经验证。
blocks.en: Flat-ground ability is retained and moderate slopes improve. One −10° trial misses the arrival region; ±15° still causes falls. Inspect failure trajectories before increasing difficulty or changing rewards. A shared walking interface does not qualify this actor for the football approach controller or kick handoff.

question.zh: 为什么评测坡道不应和训练地形完全相同？
question.en: Why evaluate on terrain geometry different from training?

answer.zh: 目的是检验学到的能力能否适应新的起点与几何，而不仅是在熟悉的布局里重复动作。两种模型应共享评测条件，且评测结果不能反过来当作独立测试仍未见过的数据。
answer.en: To test transfer to new geometry and initial states. Both actors share evaluation conditions; tuning on those results makes them development data.

title.zh: 同一套平台，还能学会什么
title.en: What else can this platform teach?

blocks.zh: 您已经用 Isaac Sim 改变了任务环境，用 Isaac Lab 继续训练，并通过统一评测检验了技能的适用范围。下一章看看社区如何用不同任务、观测与奖励，让 Microduck 学会跳跃和平衡等动作。
blocks.en: You changed the world with Isaac Sim, adapted a policy in Isaac Lab and tested its scope. Next, explore community jumping and balancing tasks.

meta.zh: 第 5 章 · 技能观察与比较

title.zh: 同一机器人，可以学什么
title.en: What else can the same robot learn?

blocks.zh: 前两次训练关注行走与地形适应。社区还用强化学习训练了跳跃、篮球平衡等技能：硬件可以相同，但任务、奖励、初始状态与结束条件不同。下面的社区演示来自各项目自己的仿真环境；它们展示技能思路，不代表已在本课程 Newton 场景或真机上通过相同评测。
blocks.en: Community projects train jumping and ball balancing using different tasks, rewards and initial states. These demonstrations come from their original simulation environments and do not establish equivalent Newton or hardware performance.

alt.zh: 社区跳跃演示，按原作品的四倍慢动作播放。观察起跳、腾空、落地以及切回站立的衔接。
alt.en: Community jump demonstration in the original four-times slow motion. Observe takeoff, flight, landing and the standing handoff.

blocks.zh: 社区跳跃演示，按原作品的四倍慢动作播放。观察起跳、腾空、落地以及切回站立的衔接。
blocks.en: Community jump demonstration in the original four-times slow motion. Observe takeoff, flight, landing and the standing handoff.

alt.zh: 社区篮球平衡演示。观察脚下支撑面随球转动而变化，机器人怎样持续调整姿态。
alt.en: Community ball-balancing demonstration: watch the moving support surface and continuous posture corrections.

blocks.zh: 社区篮球平衡演示。观察脚下支撑面随球转动而变化，机器人怎样持续调整姿态。
blocks.en: Community ball-balancing demonstration: watch the moving support surface and continuous posture corrections.

zh: 本体状态与一次性起跳指令 → 关节动作
起跳高度、落地姿态、落地后是否站稳
机器人与球的状态 → 关节动作
持续平衡、球与身体位置、存活时长
本体状态与速度指令 → 关节动作
速度跟踪、稳定性、能耗与动作平滑性
en: Body state and a jump command → joint actions
Robot and ball state → joint actions
Body state and velocity command → joint actions
Speed tracking, stability, energy and smoothness

blocks.zh: 迁移这些技能时，可在 Isaac Sim 添加对应的道具和接触几何，再通过 Isaac Lab 配置观测、奖励与重置分布。输入都是 61 维，也不保证模型能直接互换：例如社区跳跃把速度指令的第一个分量用作起跳开关，必须遵循该技能的接口约定。
blocks.en: Isaac Sim supplies props and contact geometry; Isaac Lab organizes observations, rewards and reset distributions. Equal observation dimensions do not guarantee compatibility: the jump policy repurposes a command field as a launch trigger.

blocks.zh: 行走策略可以持续接收速度指令，而踢球是一个有明确起止点的短时技能。Isaac Lab 的任务结构便于复用相同的观测、动作与执行器接口，并用命令、事件和终止条件表达技能边界；Newton 的接触与机身状态则让“脚确实碰球”和“机器人恢复站稳”成为可检查条件。要把踢球接入自主任务，除了定义动作本身，还必须说明何时允许启动、结束后应进入什么状态，以及发生失败时如何停止。
blocks.en: Walking continuously accepts velocity commands. A kick is a short skill with a start and an end. Integrating it into an autonomous task requires entry conditions, a defined exit state, and a way to stop when conditions are unsafe.

zh: 球是否在可踢区域，身体朝向是否合适，观测是否仍在有效期内
由真实足部接触推动球，而不是直接修改球状态
及时结束出脚并回到支撑状态
机器人保持稳定，没有摔倒或关节越界
en: Body state and a jump command → joint actions
Robot and ball state → joint actions
Body state and velocity command → joint actions
Speed tracking, stability, energy and smoothness

title.zh: 为什么两个 ONNX 不能随意互换
title.en: Why ONNX files are not interchangeable

blocks.zh: ONNX 只是一种模型表示格式，并不是统一的机器人技能协议。行走模型读取 61 维输入，当前踢球残差模型读取 62 维输入；即使两者都输出 14 个数，也不能直接互换。输入顺序、附加状态、动作缩放、教师混合方式和结束条件都属于模型的运行约定。
blocks.en: ONNX is a model representation, not a universal robot-skill protocol. The walking model takes 61 inputs, while the kicking residual takes 62. Both output 14 numbers, yet they are not interchangeable. Input ordering, additional state, action scaling, teacher blending, and termination conditions are all part of the runtime contract.

blocks.zh: 运行本章的模型检查命令后，请分别记录输入和输出形状，再解释为什么“文件能够成功加载”只能证明模型格式可读，却不能证明机器人能够完成动作。模型文件本身可能完全合法，但接收到的单位或关节顺序仍可能错误。固定任务入口会把权重与这些运行约定配套使用。
blocks.en: After inspecting the models, record their input and output shapes. Explain why successfully loading a file only proves that its format is readable, not that the robot will perform a skill. A valid file can still receive the wrong units or joint order. The fixed task entry point uses weights together with their required conventions.

blocks.zh: 观看出脚过程时，可以分三个阶段观察：出脚前，检查球与支撑脚的位置是否合适；出脚过程中，观察摆动腿是否形成足够空间，并用物理接触记录确认接触来自脚部而非身体其他部位；出脚后，观察重心是否重新回到支撑区域、机身倾角是否收敛。请分别描述技能的进入条件与完成条件。相比只看“球有没有动”，这种观察方式更能反映机器人系统的实际要求。
blocks.en: Watch the kick in three phases: before it, inspect ball and support-foot positions; during it, identify whether contact comes from the foot or another body part; afterwards, inspect recovery of support. Pause the video in each phase and describe the entry and completion conditions. This is more informative than asking only whether the ball moved.

title.zh: 用输入、输出与结束条件描述技能
title.en: Describe a skill by its contract

blocks.zh: 描述一项技能时，可以拆分为四部分：进入条件、所用观测、输出动作和退出时机。以射门为例，球必须位于适合右脚出脚的位置，机身朝向球门，支撑保持稳定，而且目标观测尚未过期。技能执行期间会结合踢球教师策略与残差修正；结束后还必须恢复到稳定的站立或行走状态，不能把“已经碰到球”直接当作任务完成。
blocks.en: Describe a skill using entry conditions, observations, actions, and exit conditions. A kick requires a useful right-foot ball position, goal alignment, stable support, and fresh target information. Execution combines the kicking teacher with a residual correction. It must then return to a stable standing or walking state; touching the ball alone does not finish the task.

blocks.zh: 残差可以看作对已有动作施加的受约束修正。这样做缩小了需要从头学习的问题范围，同时也会继承教师策略的适用边界。如果在远离球的位置启动局部射门技能，它不会因此自动学会找球或接近目标。导航模块负责创造技能可以接手的条件，技能模块则负责完成局部动作。
blocks.en: A residual adds a constrained correction to an existing action. This reduces what must be learned from scratch but inherits the teacher’s operating range. Starting a local kick far from the ball does not make it search or approach. Navigation creates a valid handoff state; the skill performs its local action.

question.zh: 机器人已走到球旁，但球的位置记忆过期。应立刻运行踢球技能吗？
question.en: The robot is beside the ball, but its remembered position has expired. Should the kick start immediately?

answer.zh: 不应立即运行。需要先重新观察并确认进入条件；仅仅靠近目标，并不能保证技能输入仍然有效。
answer.en: No. Observe again and confirm the entry conditions. Proximity alone does not guarantee valid inputs.

title.zh: 会执行动作，还不等于会完成任务
title.en: Executing a skill is not completing a task

blocks.zh: 目前主要由我们告诉机器人“向前走”“现在跳”或“现在踢”。策略已经利用关节角度、速度和 IMU 保持平衡，但它还没有根据外部场景自己决定足球在哪里、该走哪条路、什么时候出脚。Microduck 还有相机和测距传感器：能否把这些信息用起来，让它自己踢进球门？下一章先设计完整的信息链路。
blocks.en: These policies already use joint and IMU feedback for balance. They do not yet decide where the football is, which route to take or when to kick. The next chapter designs that external-perception and planning chain.

blocks.label: 自主射门的处理流程

blocks.zh: 不是每一环都需要训练一个模型。检测与运动控制使用神经网络；坐标变换、站位计算、路径规划和任务状态切换可以使用明确的几何或规则。NVIDIA Isaac Sim 让这些模块共享同一场景与传感器，Isaac Lab 则负责训练和可重复评测运动能力。
blocks.en: Not every stage needs a learned model. Detection and motion use networks; geometry, path planning and task transitions can use explicit algorithms. Isaac Sim connects the scene and sensors; Isaac Lab trains and evaluates motion skills.

Ball, goal direction and kick offset

blocks.zh: Isaac Sim 在同一 USD 场景中生成与机器人头部姿态同步的 RTX RGB 和深度图，课程再把深度按 VL53L8CX 的 8 × 8 视区采样。RGB 检测器判断哪些区域可能是球，ToF 提供前方分区距离，机身 IMU 帮助在正确坐标系中解释射线。这样可重复改变视角、距离和姿态并保留时间戳；但 ToF 不是环视激光雷达，任何一种传感器也不能独立给出完整世界状态。
blocks.en: The RGB detector finds image regions resembling a ball. ToF measures ranges across an 8 × 8 forward-facing grid; it is not a 360-degree lidar. A body IMU estimates attitude so image rays and ranges can be interpreted in the right frame. No single sensor supplies the complete world state.

blocks.zh: 本课程的 Beta 仿真配置采用 GC2093 相机和 VL53L8CX ToF，图像处理分辨率为 960 × 540，频率为 15 Hz。镜头视场、畸变、噪声和安装位姿都是明确的仿真假设，迁移到真实设备时必须重新标定。当前传感器 rig 只提供 RGB、深度、IMU 和时间信息，没有把 Isaac Sim 的物体语义真值交给控制器，也不会自动生成本章练习集的 YOLO 标签。
blocks.en: The Beta simulation uses GC2093 camera and VL53L8CX ToF profiles. Images are processed at 960 × 540 and 15 Hz. Lens field of view and noise settings are simulation assumptions; physical devices require calibration.

title.zh: 从一个像素到一条空间射线
title.en: From a pixel to a spatial ray

blocks.zh: 在光学相机坐标系中，像素 \( (u,v) \) 对应的射线方向与 \( [(u-c_x)/f_x,\,(v-c_y)/f_y,\,1]^{\mathsf T} \) 成比例。内参中的 \(f_x,f_y\) 是以像素为单位的焦距，\(c_x,c_y\) 是主点。射线只表示方向；确定距离还需要已知几何或其他传感器提供约束。
blocks.en: Let a detection center be pixel (u, v), with camera focal lengths (fx, fy) and principal point (cx, cy). In a common camera convention, the viewing ray is proportional to ((u−cx)/fx, (v−cy)/fy, 1). This gives direction but cannot distinguish a small nearby object from a larger distant one. Range or a known geometric constraint is still needed.

blocks.zh: 相机坐标系通常规定 x 轴向右、y 轴向下、z 轴向前；本课程的机身坐标系则规定 x 轴向前、y 轴向左、z 轴向上。两者之间必须依据相机相对于机身的旋转和平移进行变换，不能直接把同名坐标轴上的数值相加。头部转动也会改变这一变换，因此目标定位必须使用对应时刻的头部关节状态。
blocks.en: Camera coordinates commonly use x right, y down, z forward. Here the body convention is x forward, y left, z up. Transform using the camera’s rotation and translation relative to the body rather than mixing same-named axes. Head motion changes this transform, so localization requires joint state at the appropriate time.

blocks.zh: ToF 的 8 × 8 距离网格并不是 64 个独立的物体标签。单个网格可能同时覆盖地面和球，近距离反射也可能产生无效读数。应先检查测距状态和有效范围，再判断这些数据能否支持图像中的目标。若把“没有有效测量”误解为“前方没有障碍”，后续导航就会建立在错误前提上。
blocks.en: An 8 × 8 ToF grid does not provide 64 independent object labels. One cell may cover both floor and ball, and close reflections may be invalid. Check measurement status and range before associating a return with an image target. Treating an invalid reading as an obstacle-free direction gives navigation a false premise.

title.zh: 曾经看见，不等于现在仍然知道
title.en: A past observation can become stale

blocks.zh: 机器人移动或低头后，球可能暂时离开画面。虽然可以利用里程计在短时间内更新球的相对位置，但这种记忆会不断累积误差。一旦观测过期、ToF 数据无效或地面约束丢失，就应停止移动并重新观察，不能把缺失数据当作空地。
blocks.en: After moving or tilting its head, the robot may lose the ball from view. Odometry can update a remembered relative position briefly, but error accumulates. Stale observations, invalid ranges, or lost ground constraints require stopping and reobserving. Missing data is not free space.

question.zh: 检测器画出了准确的球框，就可以直接把球框中心当作世界坐标吗？
question.en: If a ball box is accurate, can its center be used directly as a world coordinate?

answer.zh: 不能。像素位置只能表示图像中的方向，还需要相机模型、相机姿态以及距离或几何约束，才能估计目标的空间位置。
answer.en: No. Pixels give an image direction. Spatial position also requires a camera model, camera pose, and distance or geometric constraints.

title.en: The ball center is not the destination

blocks.zh: 如果直接朝球心前进，机器人可能提前撞到球，也可能从不利于出脚的一侧接近。更合理的目标应位于球的后方：先根据球指向球门的方向确定射门轴，再沿反方向退开一段距离，同时为出脚脚掌预留横向偏移。
blocks.en: Walking straight toward the ball center can cause premature contact or approach from the wrong side. A useful target lies behind the ball. The ball-to-goal direction defines the shooting axis; move backward along it and account for the kicking foot’s lateral offset.

blocks.zh:
二维几何练习

先用已知坐标计算准备站位，再与下方手算结果对照。这一步只验证几何关系，不运行物理仿真。
blocks.en:
A planar geometry exercise

Direction d = (goal − ball) / ‖goal − ball‖
Target target = ball − distance × d + lateral × normal(d)

blocks.zh: 预期结果：程序输出站位坐标、朝向和平面示意图。改变球的横向位置后，观察目标点如何随之移动。此处使用已知二维点练习几何关系；在真正的自主运行中，输入将来自传感器估计。
blocks.en: Expected result: a target position, heading, and a planar diagram. Change the ball’s lateral coordinate and observe how the target moves. This exercise uses known 2D points to teach geometry; autonomous execution uses sensor estimates.

title.zh: 路径规划与行走控制如何分工
title.en: How path planning and walking divide the work

blocks.zh: 路径规划器会在空间表示中寻找从起点到终点的路线。例如，占据栅格把地面划分成小格，并分别记录障碍、可通行区域和未知区域。机器人具有实际体积，不能把自身视为数学意义上的点，从任意狭窄缝隙中穿过。因此，为机器人外形保留安全余量，是把几何路径转化为可执行运动的必要步骤。
blocks.en: A planner searches for a route through a representation of space. An occupancy grid divides the floor into cells for obstacles, free space, and unknown space. A robot has a footprint: it cannot pass through every gap that admits a mathematical point. Reserving clearance is necessary when turning a geometric route into executable motion.

blocks.zh: 在完整任务中，Isaac Sim 提供带时间戳的 RGB/ToF 观测，课程桥接器把一次不可变的传感器快照、地图和目标交给隔离运行的 ROS 2 Nav2/Navfn CPU 服务，再取回路径。这里没有使用 Isaac Sim 内置 ROS 2 Action Graph，也没有让 Nav2 直接发布 /cmd_vel；真正维持双足平衡的仍是固定行走策略。上层路径与目标、下层步态执行分开后，可以分别检查规划输入、路径结果和实际跟踪误差。
blocks.en: Nav2 provides CPU navigation services in the full task, while the walking policy maintains bipedal balance. The upper layer requests a target or velocity; the lower layer drives servos. Actuator delay and gait error can move the robot away from its plan, so the system must observe and reconsider instead of assuming exact command execution.

blocks.zh: 本章的手算实验只研究出脚目标，既不调用 Nav2，也不设置障碍物。完整任务采用一台机器人、一个球和一个球门的空场环境。若自行加入障碍，必须重新检查传感器覆盖范围、未知区域处理、路径余量和碰撞结果；课程记录的空场表现不能外推为避障表现。
blocks.en: The hand-calculation exercise studies stance geometry only: it does not call Nav2 or place obstacles. The full task uses one robot, ball, and goal in an empty field. Adding obstacles requires new checks for sensor coverage, unknown space, clearance, and collisions. Empty-field results do not establish obstacle-avoidance performance.

blocks.zh: 距离较远时，可以优先缩短与球之间的距离；接近后则应减小移动幅度，同时检查球是否仍然可见、机身朝向是否正确，以及脚掌与球的相对位置是否合适。即使距离已经足够近，只要朝向不正确，就仍不应出脚。
blocks.en: At a distance, reducing range is the main priority. Nearby, motion must become more precise while preserving visibility, heading, and foot placement. Being close enough is not sufficient if heading is wrong.

blocks.zh: 导航规划器负责给出路线或方向，行走策略负责实际执行。规划器找到可行路径，并不代表机器人已经沿该路径走完全程；Isaac Sim 的可重复场景便于同时回看相机、俯视轨迹和物理接触，完整系统仍必须处理策略跟踪误差、执行器延迟、接触事件和传感器更新。
blocks.en: A planner supplies a route or direction; the walking policy executes it. A valid planned path does not prove the robot has traversed it. The system must handle tracking errors, contact, and sensor updates.

alt.zh: 接近目标并调整出脚站位的片段

blocks.zh: 只观察接近与调整站位：需要控制的是球相对身体的位置和朝向，而不是单纯让画面中的球越来越大。
blocks.en: Focus on approach and stance adjustment: control relative position and heading, not just apparent ball size.

blocks.zh: 先用球门中心减去球的位置，得到从球指向球门的方向，再将该方向归一化。站位位于球的后方：从球的位置沿该方向反向移动 distance，再沿垂直方向偏移 lateral，为出脚腿留出空间。偏移方向是这项几何练习中的约定，不能直接替代真实技能入口的标定值。
blocks.en: Subtract the ball position from the goal center and normalize the result to obtain the shooting direction. The stance lies behind the ball: move back by distance along that direction, then sideways by lateral to allow space for the kicking leg. This exercise defines its own offset convention; it does not replace calibrated entry values in the physical skill.

blocks.zh: 打开生成的 plan.svg，检查目标点、球和球门之间的相对关系；plan.json 中记录了目标坐标与朝向。把距离从 0.18 改为 0.25，并使用另一个输出目录：先预测目标点会向哪个方向移动，再用结果验证预测。该命令只计算已知点之间的几何关系，既没有运行物理仿真，也不能证明目标实际可达。
blocks.en: Open plan.svg to inspect the stance, ball, and goal. plan.json gives the target position and heading. Change distance from 0.18 to 0.25 with a new output directory; predict the direction of movement and check it. This command computes geometry from known points. It runs no physics and does not prove reachability.

blocks.zh: 完整任务还需要应对机身偏航漂移、步态延迟以及近距离目标离开视野等情况。因此，接近过程中必须持续更新观测并检查停止条件。当有效距离信息或地面支持丢失时，应先停止或在约束下后退，再重新观察；未知区域不能直接当作空闲区域。
blocks.en: The full task also handles yaw drift, delayed gait response, and targets leaving view at close range. Approach therefore updates observations and checks stopping conditions repeatedly. If valid range or floor support is lost, stop or retreat within constraints and observe again. Unknown space cannot be declared free space.

title.zh: 什么时候需要再看一眼
title.en: When should the robot look again?

alt.zh: 只看观察足球与调整头部的片段：画面中的目标位置随距离和头部姿态改变。
alt.en: A focused view of ball observation and head motion.

blocks.zh: 只看观察足球与调整头部的片段：画面中的目标位置随距离和头部姿态改变。
blocks.en: A focused view of ball observation and head motion.

blocks.zh: 一次观察可以给出起始目标，但机器人走动后，相对位置会变化，姿态与里程估计也会积累误差。相机低头找球、抬头看球门，解决的是视野与精度问题；必要时再观察，比把过期位置当成当前事实更可靠。当前课程保留出脚前的位置核验。后退仅在观察或站位条件不足时作为恢复选项，正常成功流程可以直接接近并射门。
blocks.en: A first observation supplies an initial target, but motion changes relative geometry and estimation error accumulates. The current controller verifies position before kicking. Retreat is a recovery option, not a mandatory phase.

question.zh: 若球在相机里消失，为什么不能立即按最后的坐标出脚？
question.en: Why not kick at the last known location when the ball leaves view?

answer.zh: 目标可能因机器人运动而改变相对位置，最后一次估计也可能过期。应先检查时间戳、姿态与站位条件，必要时重新观察。
answer.en: Motion changes relative position and the estimate may be stale. Check time, pose and stance before kicking; reobserve when necessary.

meta.zh: 第 7 章 · 综合实验 · 建议预留 40 分钟 · GPU

alt.zh: 这是固定检测器对练习集中八张不同图像的真实输出拼图。每个分格都是彼此独立的静态样本，不是动画或连续相机视频，也不能用于衡量推理速度。
alt.en: Actual fixed-detector outputs on eight different sample images, one image per second. These are separate static samples, not a continuous camera video or inference-speed measurement.

blocks.zh: 这是固定检测器对练习集中八张不同图像的真实输出拼图。每个分格都是彼此独立的静态样本，不是动画或连续相机视频，也不能用于衡量推理速度。
blocks.en: Actual fixed-detector outputs on eight different sample images, one image per second. These are separate static samples, not a continuous camera video or inference-speed measurement.

blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py detect \
  --model models/detector.pt \
  --source datasets/sample/images \
  --output outputs/detection-01
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 预期结果：生成标有球和球门检测框的图片。请逐张检查球体较小、靠近画面边缘或受到遮挡时的检测表现。检测置信度只是模型给出的分数，并不能保证目标判断一定正确。
blocks.en: Expected result: images with ball and goal detections. Inspect small targets, image boundaries, and occlusion. Confidence is a model score, not a guarantee that a detection is correct.

blocks.zh: 小样本和 5 个 epoch 只用于体验数据准备、标注、训练和验证流程，并不是完整的训练方案。请打开输出目录中的损失曲线和验证图片，检查标签是否正确覆盖球与球门。如需正式提升效果，应增加场景多样性，并严格分开训练、验证和测试场景。
blocks.en: The small dataset and five epochs introduce data, labels, training, and validation; this is not a full training recipe. Inspect loss curves and validation images. To improve quality, diversify scenes and keep training, validation, and test scenes separate.

title.zh: 后续仍使用课程检测器

blocks.zh: 本章的检测练习与完整任务默认加载 models/detector.pt，短训练产生的模型不会替换该文件。检测 mAP 衡量的是检测质量，不能等同于机器人的射门成功率。
blocks.en: Chapters 6 and 7 use models/detector.pt by default. The practice model does not replace it. Detection mAP measures detection quality, not shooting success.

blocks.zh: 练习集共包含 40 张图像，按照 24 / 8 / 8 划分为训练集、验证集和测试集。类别编号 0 表示球，1 表示球门。YOLO 标签的每一行采用 class cx cy width height 格式，后四项均按图像宽高归一化。例如，中心横坐标 0.5 表示画面宽度的一半，而不是世界坐标中的 0.5 米。Isaac Sim 支持为受控场景构建合成数据与标注流程，这有助于系统覆盖视角、光照和遮挡；本课程当前小数据集仍应按其现有标签检查，不能把场景中的物理真值或语义 ID 当作检测器已经见过的答案。
blocks.en: The sample has 40 images split into 24 training, 8 validation, and 8 test images. Class 0 is the ball and class 1 the goal. Each YOLO label row is class cx cy width height, with the last four values normalized by image dimensions. A horizontal center of 0.5 means halfway across the image, not 0.5 meters in the world.

blocks.zh: 请从推理输出中各选一张检测正确的图像和一张困难样本，分别检查漏检、误检与检测框偏移，并观察同一物体在大小和位置上的变化。再高的置信度也无法修复相机标定错误，更不能让二维检测框自动获得深度信息。进入导航阶段前，还必须检查距离、姿态、时间戳和数据有效性。
blocks.en: Choose one clear prediction and one difficult example. Check missed objects, false detections, and misplaced boxes, then compare object size and position. High confidence cannot repair camera calibration or turn a 2D box into depth. Navigation still requires range, attitude, timestamps, and validity checks.

question.zh: 标签中的球框中心为 (0.6, 0.4)，是否可以直接作为导航目标 (0.6 m, 0.4 m)？
question.en: Can a ball label centered at (0.6, 0.4) be used directly as a navigation target at (0.6 m, 0.4 m)?

answer.zh: 不能。这是归一化图像坐标。需要相机模型和距离或地面约束，才能得到机器人坐标中的位置。
answer.en: No. These are normalized image coordinates. A camera model and range or ground constraint are needed to obtain robot-relative position.

title.zh: 先验证出脚站位的计算

blocks.zh: 打开输出目录中的 plan.svg，对照上一章的公式检查目标点。这里使用手工给定的坐标，仅验证几何计算；完整任务会从传感器估计目标位置，再调用导航和运动技能。
blocks.en: Inspect plan.svg and compare with the previous chapter’s equation. This exercise checks geometry with supplied points; the full task obtains targets from sensors.

title.zh: 理解固定教师策略与残差模型
title.en: Understand a teacher and a residual

blocks.zh: 课程中的踢球组合由固定的基础动作策略和已经训练好的残差模型构成。残差模型在基础动作之上进行修正，因此两者的输入、动作尺度、执行器和时序必须相互匹配。缺少其中任意一个文件，剩余部分都不能再视为同一项完整技能。
blocks.en: The course kick combines a fixed base policy with a trained residual model. The residual adjusts the base behavior, so observations, action scale, actuators, and timing must match. Removing one model does not leave an equivalent skill.

blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py inspect-model --model models/kick-teacher.onnx
python3 scripts/workshop.py inspect-model --model models/kick-residual.onnx
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 请在模型清单中找到这两个文件，比较各自的输入与输出形状，并注明哪些输入来自机器人状态、哪些来自任务目标。本章后续的完整任务会调用它们，这里无需重新训练。
blocks.en: Find both files in the model inventory. Compare their input and output shapes and distinguish robot-state inputs from task inputs. The complete task uses the pair in Chapter 7; retraining is not required here.

blocks.zh: 完整系统并不是由单个网络直接输出“进球”指令。Isaac Lab 组织任务接口与控制管理器，Newton 推进物理和执行器状态，Isaac Sim 6.2 提供 GUI、RTX 相机与深度传感器；独立的 ROS 2 Nav2 CPU 服务负责路径规划。固定行走策略控制机身，检测器提供视觉目标，ToF 测距和 IMU 姿态用于约束目标的相对位置，状态机决定何时观察、行走和踢球，最后由踢球组合完成出脚与恢复。
blocks.en: This is not a single network issuing a “score” command. A walking policy controls the body, a detector supplies visual targets, range and attitude constrain relative position, a state machine decides when to observe, walk, and kick, and the kick models execute contact and recovery.

alt.zh: 一次完整的直接射门示例，保留开始、观察、接近、出脚和站稳，没有后退。按仿真时间播放，单次示例不代表总体成功率。
alt.en: One complete direct-shot example, including observation, approach, kick and recovery with no retreat. Playback follows simulation time; one example is not a success-rate estimate.

blocks.zh: 一次完整的直接射门示例，保留开始、观察、接近、出脚和站稳，没有后退。按仿真时间播放，单次示例不代表总体成功率。
blocks.en: One complete direct-shot example, including observation, approach, kick and recovery with no retreat. Playback follows simulation time; one example is not a success-rate estimate.

blocks.zh: 预期结果：Isaac Sim 窗口打开后，机器人自主执行找球、接近和对准，并尝试完成射门。程序使用仓库中的固定模型，同时保存视频、轨迹和结果。控制器只接收带时间戳的相机、ToF 与本体观测；Newton 中的精确物体位姿和接触真值只用于独立评分。180 秒指仿真中的任务预算，并不是现实中的等待时长；首次初始化和 RTX 渲染可能耗时更久。
blocks.en: Expected result: an Isaac simulation window opens and one robot searches, approaches, aligns, and attempts a kick autonomously. The program uses the repository’s fixed models and saves video, traces, and results. The 180-second budget is simulation time, not wall-clock waiting time. Initialization and rendering can take longer.

blocks.zh: 这个种子是从成功示例中选出的，仅用于教学观察和相同场景下的对照，不能再计入新的独立成功率样本。运行期间不要手动移动机器人或球；如需中止，请在终端按 Ctrl+C，并保留已经生成的日志。
blocks.en: This seed is a selected teaching fixture drawn from successful examples. It supports comparison on the same scene and is not a new independent success-rate sample. Do not manually move the robot or ball during execution. To stop, press Ctrl+C in the terminal and retain the logs.

zh: 确实发生足部与球的接触。
整个球越过球门线，并位于有效门框内。
机器人没有摔倒，动作没有超出规定机械范围。
没有在正式出脚前意外碰球，踢完后恢复站稳。
en: The entire ball crossed the goal plane inside the opening.
The robot did not fall or exceed the specified mechanical bounds.
There was no premature ball contact, and the robot recovered after kicking.

title.zh: 怎样理解课程参考结果

blocks.zh: 在课程记录的那组测试中，这组固定模型在 10 个独立空场回合里完成了 9 次完整任务。该结果只是特定版本和场景分布下的小样本记录，不能推广为任意种子、障碍场景或真实机器人的普遍成功率。障碍场景和真实机器人均不属于本课程已经验证的主线。
blocks.en: The fixed combination completed 9 of 10 independent empty-field episodes. This is a small-sample observation for specific versions and a scene distribution, not a guarantee for arbitrary seeds, obstacles, or hardware. Obstacles and real-robot deployment are outside the validated main path.

blocks.zh: 开始运行前，应先写明测试种子和成功标准。每个回合至少要记录进球、摔倒、触球和恢复情况，不能通过悄悄重跑来替换失败结果。模型或参数一旦改变，就应作为另一组实验单独比较。
blocks.en: Write down seeds and success criteria before running. Record goals, falls, contact, and recovery for every episode. Do not replace a failure with a retry. A model or parameter change defines a separate experiment.

question.zh: 检测器 mAP 很高、行走模型也能保持站立，为什么整次任务仍可能失败？
question.en: Why can the task fail even when detection mAP is high and the walking policy stays upright?

answer.zh: 完整任务能否成功，取决于各模块是否正确交接。目标可能暂时不可见，坐标信息可能不适用于当前时刻，观测也可能已经过期，站位和朝向还可能不满足出脚条件。因此，各模块的单项指标不能代替端到端评测。
answer.en: Success depends on interfaces between modules. Targets can leave view, coordinates or observation age can become unsuitable, and position or heading may fail the kick conditions. Module metrics do not replace end-to-end evaluation.

title.en: Locate a problem from a failed run

blocks.zh: 首先检查程序是否正常生成 result.json。如果文件不存在，请查看终端末尾的错误，并排查安装或运行条件；这种情况属于执行失败。如果结果文件存在，则要进一步区分“没有找到球”“无法形成出脚站位”“球被碰到但未进门”“进门后未稳定恢复”等行为失败。程序正常退出，并不代表机器人已经完成任务。
blocks.en: First check whether result.json was produced. If not, inspect the terminal error and installation or runtime conditions: that is an execution failure. If results exist, distinguish failure to find the ball, failure to reach a kicking stance, contact without a goal, and failure to recover after scoring. A normal process exit does not mean the robot completed the task.

blocks.zh: 结果中的 course_evaluation.passed 综合了完整物理评分和适用检查结果，scorer 则保存接触、越线和摔倒等信息。回看同步视角时，应同时检查第一次触球前的站位和出脚后的姿态；不能只截取球越过门线的几秒来判断整个流程。
blocks.en: course_evaluation.passed combines physical scoring and applicable checks. scorer retains contact, goal crossing, and fall information. In synchronized views, inspect the stance before first contact and posture after kicking. A short clip of the ball crossing the line is insufficient for a full-task judgment.

blocks.zh: 在课程记录的那组空场独立测试中，这组固定模型完成了 9/10。该数字仅是特定环境、场景分布和时间预算下的历史结果，不能视为一般成功率。默认种子 983102 用于教学演示，重复运行同一种子不会产生新的独立样本；自选种子、不同设备、障碍物和真实硬件都必须另行评测。
blocks.en: The fixed combination completed 9/10 recorded independent empty-field trials under a particular environment, distribution, and time budget. The default seed 983102 is a teaching example; repeating it does not establish a new independent success rate. New seeds, different devices, obstacles, and real hardware require separate evaluation.

title.zh: 回顾与延伸：在更复杂的球场上射门
title.en: Recap and a harder football challenge

summary.zh: 从调用一个技能，到训练新技能，再到把感知、规划与动作连接成自主任务。最后，设计一个更有挑战性的实验。
summary.en: Recap and a harder football challenge. Explore the concepts, run the lab, and inspect its results.

title.en: From skills to a complete task

blocks.zh: Isaac Sim 提供可观察、可重置的世界；Isaac Lab 将经验采集、策略学习与评测组织成可重复的实验。
blocks.en: Isaac Sim provides an observable, resettable world. Isaac Lab organizes experience collection, policy learning and evaluation into reproducible experiments.

zh: 加载官方 ONNX，用键盘给出指令
观察关节、受力路径、传感器与控制周期
用 PPO 和并行环境采集经验，导出并测试策略
保持测试条件一致，比较平地与不同坡度
把感知、定位、规划、行走与踢球连接起来
en: Load official ONNX actors and issue keyboard commands
Inspect joints, load paths, sensors and control timing
Collect parallel experience, update PPO and export an actor
Compare flat ground and slopes under matched conditions
Connect perception, localization, planning, walking and kicking

blocks.zh: 一个动作策略解决“怎样动”；完整系统还要解决“要做什么、目标在哪里、信息是否可信、何时切换动作”。成功率来自整个链路，而不是某个模型文件的名字。始终把单次演示、技能评测和端到端任务评测分开理解。
blocks.en: A motion actor solves how to move. A complete system also decides what to do, where the target is, whether information is reliable and when to switch skills. Keep demonstrations, skill benchmarks and task-level evaluation distinct.

title.zh: 延伸问题：坡地、坑洼与障碍物
title.en: Challenge: slopes, uneven ground and obstacles

blocks.zh: 假设足球在一个有坡度、局部不平整并带有障碍的球场中。机器人还能像第 7 章一样完成射门吗？本课程暂不实现这个任务，请先设计方案，明确哪些已有能力可复用、哪些假设必须修改。
blocks.en: Suppose the pitch has slopes, uneven patches and obstacles. Can the robot still score? This is a design challenge only; it is not implemented in the course.

zh: 行走策略能否保持平衡？球会不会在尚未触碰时自行滚动？
平面投影 z = 0 是否仍成立？是否需要局部地面高度或深度？
如何建立占据地图、为机器人留出空间，并在目标变化后重新规划？
平地踢球的起始姿态、球相对位置和恢复条件还有效吗？
怎样分别定位感知、导航、动作失败，避免只统计最终进球？
en: Can the actor balance? Does the ball roll before contact?
Is projection onto z = 0 valid? Is local surface height or depth needed?
How can a map provide clearance and support replanning?
Are the flat-ground starting pose, ball relation and recovery conditions still valid?
How can perception, navigation and motion failures be separated?

blocks.zh: 建议把提案写成一页：场景变量与范围、传感器输入、可复用模型、需要新训练的部分、训练与测试的划分、通过条件和计算预算。用 Isaac Sim 构建场景，用 Isaac Lab 组织地形与技能评测；只有确实需要的新能力才启动新训练。
blocks.en: Draft a one-page proposal: scene variables, sensors, reusable policies, new training needs, data splits, success criteria and compute budget. Use Isaac Sim for scenes and Isaac Lab for terrain and skill evaluation.

question.zh: 为什么不能把“坡地行走通过”与“平地射门通过”相加，直接宣称“坡地自主射门通过”？
question.en: Why do slope walking and flat-pitch shooting not establish slope-pitch autonomous shooting?

answer.zh: 两个子系统在新的组合场景里会互相影响。球可能滚动，定位假设可能失效，出脚姿态也变了；必须对完整任务重新做独立评测。
answer.en: The combined task changes ball motion, localization assumptions and kicking conditions. It needs its own end-to-end evaluation.

summary.zh: 所有主线实验使用明确命名的固定文件。下载一次，即可在各章节重复使用。
summary.en: Every main-path lab uses explicitly named fixed files. Download once and reuse them across chapters.

title.zh: 练习数据与自己的输出

blocks.zh: datasets/sample/ 是一套小型图像与标签练习集，用于体验检测推理和短训练流程，但不足以证明模型能够泛化到真实环境。自行训练的模型和日志应保存在 outputs/，不要将其复制到 models/ 并覆盖课程文件。
blocks.en: datasets/sample/ is a small image-and-label practice set for detector inference and short training. It is not enough to establish real-world generalization. Student checkpoints and logs belong in outputs/; do not copy them over the course files in models/.

blocks.zh: 机器人几何、社区策略和依赖组件分别保留各自的来源与许可条款，课程代码的许可并不覆盖第三方资产。分发修改版本前，请先查阅仓库中的 来源与许可说明。
blocks.en: Robot geometry, community policies, and dependencies retain their source terms. The course-code license does not override third-party asset licenses. Before redistributing changes, read the repository’s attribution and license notices.

summary.zh: 从环境、文件和参数开始检查，保留失败输出，以便比较下一次运行。
summary.en: Check environment, files, and arguments first. Preserve failed outputs for comparison.

blocks.zh: 出现问题时，记录第一条失败信息通常比反复启动完整训练更有价值。请检查命令是否在仓库根目录执行、当前 Python 是否来自锁定环境，以及所有模型校验是否通过。
blocks.en: The first failure is more useful than repeatedly launching a full training run. Check the repository directory, the selected runtime, and all model checks.

zh: 使用 GPU 机器的桌面终端；检查 DISPLAY 和驱动，不要将纯命令行远程会话当作图形桌面。
查看日志是否仍在下载资源或编译；等待初始化，不要反复启动多个实例。
为新实验使用新的目录名，并保留上一次运行的结果。
先减少学生训练的环境数或检测 batch；不要同时运行多个仿真。
重新获取仓库中的原模型，确认没有覆盖固定文件。
自训练模型行走效果不佳
短训练仅用于体验流程，不保证策略表现。比较奖励、回合长度和独立测试表现；下一章继续使用固定模型。
机器人停止或没有进球
查看任务结果和观测有效性。信息不足时，停止可能是正确行为，但不能据此判定射门成功。
en: Use the GPU desktop terminal and check DISPLAY and the driver. A remote text shell is not a graphical desktop.
Check for downloads and compilation. Allow initialization and avoid starting duplicate instances.
Choose a new run name and preserve the previous result.
Reduce training environments or detector batch size. Avoid concurrent simulations.
Restore the repository model and check for accidental overwrites.
A short run teaches the workflow. Inspect reward, episode length, and evaluation. Continue with fixed models.
Robot stops or does not score
Inspect the task report and observation validity. Stopping can be appropriate when information is missing; it is not a goal.

blocks.zh: 提交问题时，请附上运行命令、随机种子、环境检查结果和第一条报错信息。仅写“成功”或“失败”不足以定位问题，同时不要发送账户密码或访问令牌。
blocks.en: When reporting an issue, include the command, seed, environment report, and first error. A success/failure label alone is not enough. Do not include passwords or access tokens.

summary.zh: 按课程主题查阅官方源码、文档和论文。
summary.en: Find official source code, documentation, and papers by topic.

blocks.zh: 建议先从任务配置入手，理解观测、动作和奖励，再进一步研究物理引擎与传感器接口。课程使用的是固定版本，而官方文档可能已经介绍更新版本，因此比较参数前必须先核对版本。
blocks.en: Begin with task observations, actions, and rewards, then explore physics and sensors. Course commands target fixed versions; current documentation may describe newer versions. Check the version before applying changes.

zh: 调整第三章的训练预算，并在相同的独立测试种子上比较表现。
为第七章补充具有不同背景和光照条件的图像，检查检测器的泛化表现。
用第七章的工具可视化不同球位对应的准备站位和朝向。
为第七章预先确定一组新种子，并完整记录所有成功与失败结果。
en: Vary the Chapter 3 training budget and compare on the same unseen seeds.
Add backgrounds and lighting conditions to Chapter 5 and evaluate generalization.
Visualize Chapter 7 target positions and headings for different ball locations.
Predefine new seeds for Chapter 7 and retain all successes and failures.
